trigger.failure: Concurrent max-turn continuation calls do not consistently coalesce to the same scheduled retry Run.
trigger.isolated_reproduction: Failed again on the first isolated run.

work_unit.title: 修复并发 max-turn continuation 幂等收敛
work_unit.goal: Preserve fail-closed execution-lock authority while allowing a concurrent duplicate to discover and reuse the continuation created for the same source Run and attempt.

invariants: An existing continuation is reusable only when company, source Run, retry reason, attempt, issue and live status all match.
If no matching continuation exists, the transaction must reject a changed issue execution lock.
Promotion of an already scheduled retry continues to enforce that the issue lock belongs to the retry Run.

tdd_plan.red: Retain the consistently failing concurrent coalescing test and add or retain changed-lock suppression coverage.
tdd_plan.green: Move execution-lock authority for scheduling into the serialized transaction after the matching-continuation lookup.
tdd_plan.refactor: Avoid duplicating or weakening the promotion gate.

commands: isolated failing regression repeated five times

stop_conditions: A changed execution lock can schedule a new continuation.
Concurrent duplicates can create multiple live retry Runs or wakeup requests.
The fix changes retry promotion behavior.
